![UnThreader](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hiraethclub/UnThreader/main/docs/screenshot.png)

A desktop app that bulk-deletes **your own** Threads **posts** and **replies**. It drives the
Threads web UI with your own logged-in session — your password never touches the app.

### Downloads

| OS | File |
| --- | --- |
| Windows | `UnThreader-0.1.1-setup.exe` |
| Linux | `UnThreader-0.1.1.AppImage` or `UnThreader-0.1.1.deb` |
| macOS | `UnThreader-0.1.1.dmg` |

The binaries are **unsigned**, so the OS warns on first launch:
- **Windows:** SmartScreen → *More info → Run anyway*
- **macOS:** right-click the app → *Open*

Deletions are permanent — start with **Dry run** (the default) to preview. Automating
Threads is against Meta's ToS; pace conservatively.
